record.field: # Force logout logic # In Odoo, we can't easily "kill" sessions from server side without deleting loading sessions. # This script will invalidate sessions. env['ir.sessions'].sudo().search([]).unlink() # Log the event env['mail.message'].create({ 'body': 'System executed 5:30 PM Auto-Logout for all users.', 'model': 'res.users', 'res_id': 1, })
